upgrades.desc: +10% damage per kill in a streak (streak bonuses cap at +60%). Triple kills explode for 250% Power (4s cooldown).

upgrades.name: Gold Fever
upgrades.desc: Every $1,000 you spend goes off as a golden blast around you for 600% Power. +30% money.

upgrades.name: Colossus
upgrades.desc: The ground shakes when you land: any jump comes down as a quake for 150% Power. +100 max health, and hits are reduced by 4.

upgrades.name: Apex Predator
upgrades.desc: +100% damage to enemies above 90% health. Elites below 20% health are culled.

upgrades.name: Master of Ceremonies
upgrades.desc: Your class ability recharges 40% faster. Using it grants +40% damage for 4s (12s cooldown).

upgrades.name: Treasure Hunter
upgrades.desc: Chests refund 25% of their price, and opening one grants 40 overshield.

upgrades.name: Warlord's Banner
upgrades.desc: +60% melee damage, heavy blows a further +50%, and +40 armor while your blade is drawn.

upgrades.name: Quick Draw
upgrades.desc: Swap guns 40% faster. +8% reload speed.

upgrades.name: Gun Belt
upgrades.desc: +25% reserve ammo, +10% magazine size.

upgrades.name: Dead Aim
upgrades.desc: +10% crit chance, 20% tighter spread.

upgrades.name: High Noon
upgrades.desc: +30% crit chance during Deadeye.

upgrades.name: Loaded for Bear
upgrades.desc: Deadeye reloads every gun you carry and lasts a second longer.

upgrades.name: Knuckle Wraps
upgrades.desc: +12% swing speed, +15% melee damage.

upgrades.name: Thick Skull
upgrades.desc: +12 armor. 8% chance to shrug off a hit completely.

upgrades.name: Haymaker
upgrades.desc: Heavy blows and chain finishers deal +60% damage.

upgrades.name: Unstoppable
upgrades.desc: Bull Rush leaves you with 40 overshield and +30% move speed for 3 seconds.

upgrades.name: Juggernaut
upgrades.desc: +50 max health. +4% melee damage per 25 max health above 150.

upgrades.name: Long Barrel
upgrades.desc: Your turret sees and shoots 30% farther.

upgrades.name: Tool Belt
upgrades.desc: +10 armor, +12% reload speed.

upgrades.name: Incendiary Belt
upgrades.desc: Your turret's shots set enemies on fire.

upgrades.name: Remote Detonator
upgrades.desc: Calling your turret to a new spot blows up the old one for 300% Power.

upgrades.name: Overwatch
upgrades.desc: Your turret fires 35% faster, hits 35% harder and reaches 25% farther.

upgrades.name: Spotter's Scope
upgrades.desc: +20% headshot damage. +15% damage to enemies beyond 20 meters.

upgrades.name: Light Pack
upgrades.desc: Grapple recharges 20% faster. +25% air control, +5% move speed.

upgrades.name: Patient Hunter
upgrades.desc: +30% damage while aiming and standing still.

upgrades.name: Second Opinion
upgrades.desc: After a headshot kill, your next shot within 3 seconds is a guaranteed crit.

upgrades.name: Killshot
upgrades.desc: Headshots kill any non-boss enemy below 30% health outright.

upgrades.name: Powder Keg
upgrades.desc: +25% grenade and Satchel Charge damage.

upgrades.name: Deep Pockets
upgrades.desc: Carry 1 more grenade. +40% pickup range.

upgrades.name: Scorched Earth
upgrades.desc: Everything your explosions hit burns for 15% of the blast each second.

upgrades.name: Recycler
upgrades.desc: 25% chance a thrown grenade is not used up.

upgrades.name: Carpet Bomber
upgrades.desc: Every grenade bursts into five more.

upgrades.name: Tune-Up
upgrades.desc: +20% damage, +15% magazine and reserve ammo, +5% fire rate and reload speed, on this gun.

enemies.name: Rotcap
enemies.desc: A toadstool that got up and walked. Slow, and there are always more.

enemies.name: Sporeling
enemies.desc: Bent double and fast. It grins because it has nothing else for a face.

enemies.name: Creeper
enemies.desc: Mycelium on six legs. Low, quick and hard to hit.

enemies.name: Puffball
enemies.desc: Swollen to bursting. Do not be near it when it does.

enemies.name: Inkcap
enemies.desc: It melts into ink as it goes, and spits it at you.

enemies.name: Blight Rat
enemies.desc: A rat the mold got into. The stalks on its back are not its own.

enemies.name: Drifter
enemies.desc: A spore pod that floats. It comes down on you mouth first.

enemies.name: Bracketback
enemies.desc: A rotten stump that stood up, shelves of fungus up its back. Hits like a falling tree.

enemies.name: Shrieker
enemies.desc: It screams through its funnel and the rest come running.

enemies.name: Rootworm
enemies.desc: A root as thick as a barrel. It comes up through the floor.

enemies.name: Golden Truffle
enemies.desc: Gone gold all through. Catch it before it digs back in.

enemies.name: Shelfshield
enemies.desc: It grew a bracket as thick as a door. Get round it.

enemies.name: Sporecaller
enemies.desc: The veiled one. Where it walks, the others grow stronger.

enemies.name: Grasping Mycel
enemies.desc: A braid of mold out of the floor. Part of something much bigger.

affixes.name: Blazing
affixes.desc: Leaves fire on the ground and burns on hit.

affixes.name: Shielded
affixes.desc: Overshield equal to half its health.

affixes.name: Vampiric
affixes.desc: Heals 50% of damage it deals; regenerates.

affixes.name: Splitting
affixes.desc: Splits into two smaller copies on death.

affixes.name: Armored
affixes.desc: Takes 50% less damage from the front and body shots.

affixes.name: Blinking
affixes.desc: Teleports toward you every few seconds.

affixes.name: Gilded
affixes.desc: Triple money and a money bag.

bosses.name: Big Tony
bosses.title: The Foreman
bosses.desc: The stockyard's enforcer. Sidestep his charge and he is winded; stand in his chain's line and he drags you into a swing.

bosses.name: The Abomination
bosses.title: Stitched Mass
bosses.desc: A dozen enemies sewn into one. It leaps, spits bile that poisons the ground, and sheds crawlers as it comes apart.

bosses.name: Mother Carrion
bosses.title: Queen of the Wisps
bosses.desc: Dives along a marked line and rains bile. Twice she wards herself: nothing hurts her until her wisps are dead.

bosses.name: The Undertaker
bosses.title: Keeper of the Nails
bosses.desc: Vanishes and swings from behind you, and lays walls of nails with a single gap to find.

bosses.name: The Gravedigger
bosses.title: Warden of Deadwater
bosses.desc: The town itself, walking. Every trick the others had, and a ward of its own at half health.

bosses.name: The Founder
bosses.title: Father of Deadwater Gulch
bosses.desc: Waits in the crypt under the clock tower. Throws blades, lights the seal and burns the room down around you.

bosses.name: The Shift Boss
bosses.title: Overseer of the Night Shift
bosses.desc: Runs the shift with a steam drill. Sidestep the charge and he is winded.

bosses.name: The Canary
bosses.title: It Stopped Singing
bosses.desc: A cage with something in it that used to warn them. Twice it wards itself behind its bats.

bosses.name: The Motherlode
bosses.title: The Seam That Walks
bosses.desc: Ore, crystal and whoever dug too close. Breaks apart into crawlers as you chip it down.

bosses.name: The King Below
bosses.title: Warden of the Lowest Level
bosses.desc: What the mine was dug to reach. Everything the others had, and a ward at half health.

bosses.name: Baron Blackwater
bosses.title: Owner of Everything Down Here
bosses.desc: He sealed the shaft with the night shift still in it. He has been waiting at the bottom ever since.

bosses.name: The Stoker
bosses.title: He Fed the Firebox
bosses.desc: Fed the firebox until it fed on him. He scatters live coals; sidestep the charge and he is winded.

bosses.name: The Conductor
bosses.title: All Tickets, Please
bosses.desc: Every ticket was punched. He steps out of the snow behind you and throws them like knives.

bosses.name: The White Widow
bosses.title: Waiting on the Platform
bosses.desc: She waited for a train that is still coming. Twice she wards herself behind her owls.

bosses.name: The Wendigo
bosses.title: The Hunger of the Pass
bosses.desc: What the pass is named for. Everything the others had, and a ward at half health.

bosses.name: The Stationmaster
bosses.title: He Never Cleared the Line
bosses.desc: Every signal on the mountain is at danger because he set it there. Nothing leaves until he says.

bosses.name: Old Scratch
bosses.title: The One They Stopped Hunting
bosses.desc: A white gator that walks upright, with every hunter's iron still in him. Sidestep the charge and he is winded.

bosses.name: Mama Skeeter
bosses.title: Every One of Them Is Hers
bosses.desc: Dives along a marked line and spits. Twice she wards herself behind her brood.

bosses.name: Deacon Moss
bosses.title: Still Preaching
bosses.desc: The lagoon is his congregation. He steps out of the mist behind you and leaves the ground burning with marsh gas.

bosses.name: The Ferryman
bosses.title: Everyone Goes Across
bosses.desc: His boat hook drags you in. Everything the others had, and a ward at half health.

bosses.name: Mother Mourn
bosses.title: The Lagoon's Own
bosses.desc: The lagoon took her, and then it was hers. Everything in the parish goes down to her in the end.

bosses.name: The Human Cannonball
bosses.title: Fired Twice Nightly
bosses.desc: He liked being fired out of the gun. Sidestep him when he comes and he ploughs on, winded.

bosses.name: Madame Zora
bosses.title: She Saw It Coming
bosses.desc: She saw the fire in the cards and stayed for it. Never where you last saw her; deals the deck at you.

bosses.name: The Twins
bosses.title: Billed as Inseparable
bosses.desc: Two of them in one coat. They come apart as you hurt them, and what comes off them runs at you.

bosses.name: Grin
bosses.title: The Last Clown
bosses.desc: He was never the funny one. Everything the others had, and a ward at half health.

bosses.name: The Ringmaster
bosses.title: The Show Must Go On
bosses.desc: He would not stop the show for a fire, so the fire joined the bill. Yours is the last act.

bosses.name: The Harbourmaster
bosses.title: Nothing Leaves Without His Say
bosses.desc: His boat hook drags you in to be hit. Sidestep the charge and he is winded.

bosses.name: The Net-Mender
bosses.title: Still Mending
bosses.desc: She mended for every boat on the wharf. Steps out of the rain behind you and leaves brine burning on the stones.

bosses.name: The Keeper
bosses.title: The Light Must Not Go Out
bosses.desc: The lamp went out the night they needed it. He is the lamp now. Twice he wards himself behind his gulls.

bosses.name: Captain Graves
bosses.title: Master of the Providence
bosses.desc: He went down with her and brought her back. Everything the others had, and a ward at half health.

bosses.name: The Hangman
bosses.title: The Wharf Is Named for His Work
bosses.desc: Every rope on the wharf is his. He has one measured for you.

bosses.name: The Brood Mother
bosses.title: She Is Not Alone In There
bosses.desc: Lays sacs that hatch unless you burst them.

bosses.name: Old Ironhide
bosses.title: Plate In Front, Hide Behind
bosses.desc: Iron plate all over. Make it miss a charge: while it stands winded, hit it hard and crack the plates off.

bosses.name: The Hive Queen
bosses.title: The Room Is Hers
bosses.desc: Never stops calling the swarm.

bosses.name: King Ooze
bosses.title: Everything It Ever Ate
bosses.desc: Kill it and it is two. Kill those and they are four.

bosses.name: The Lamplighter
bosses.title: Follow The Light
bosses.desc: Three lights in the dark and only one of them is the fish.

bosses.name: Carapace
bosses.title: The Room Is Its Shell
bosses.desc: Nothing gets through the shell. Wait for it to end up on its back.

bosses.name: The Wyrm
bosses.title: Under The Floor
bosses.desc: Goes under and comes up beneath you. Soft for a moment after.

bosses.name: Thunderhead
bosses.title: Weather With A Face
bosses.desc: It never stops raining on you. Watch the floor.

bosses.name: Ash and Ember
bosses.title: Two Of One Litter
bosses.desc: Two of them. Whichever you leave for last remembers the other.

bosses.name: The Furnace
bosses.title: It Has To Let The Heat Out
bosses.desc: Every fourth thing it does is vent. It is soft while it cools.

bosses.name: The Hydra
bosses.title: Leave It Alone And It Mends
bosses.desc: Heals whenever you stop hurting it, and wakes another head as it weakens.

bosses.name: The Mirror Queen
bosses.title: What You Send Comes Back
bosses.desc: When she shines, hold your fire: it comes back at you.

bosses.name: The Unblinking
bosses.title: It Looks And You Come
bosses.desc: Drags you toward it. Run against the pull and jump the rings.

bosses.name: The Reaper
bosses.title: You See It When It Strikes
bosses.desc: Fades from sight between strikes, and is hard to hurt while faded.

bosses.name: Grandfather Toad
bosses.title: The Mire Rises
bosses.desc: Floods the floor. The four raised slabs stay dry.

bosses.name: The Bone Dragon
bosses.title: What Burns Where The Heart Was
bosses.desc: Draws lines of fire through where you stand.

bosses.name: The Clockwork Titan
bosses.title: Wound Up Long Ago
bosses.desc: Shielded while its idols stand. Break them.

bosses.name: The Leviathan
bosses.title: Most Of It Is Still Below
bosses.desc: Cannot be hurt while its tentacles are up.
bosses.wardText: IT IS GUARDED  -  KILL THE TENTACLES

bosses.name: The Devourer
bosses.title: A Mouth That Learned To Walk
bosses.desc: Calls its food. Whatever you leave alive, it eats, and grows.

bosses.name: The Nameless
bosses.title: It Is Looking At You Out Of All Of Them
bosses.desc: Puts out the light, all but one piece. Be standing in it.

bosses.name: The Hollow King
bosses.title: Who Waits at the Bottom
bosses.desc: Kill its bearers. Carry their cinders to the three pyres. Strike the heart when it kneels.
